record.question:
Statement: All fruits are healthy. No healthy thing is junk food.

Conclusions:
I. No fruit is junk food.
II. Some junk foods are healthy.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
record.explanation: All fruits are healthy and no healthy item is junk. Hence no fruit is junk (I). Conclusion II, claiming some junk food is healthy, contradicts the second premise and does not follow. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Direction (Questions 94–96): In each question, a statement is given followed by two conclusions (I and II). Assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which conclusions logically follow.
